title: He was born in a Punjab village. In 2026, he became the first Australian to win horticulture's top global honor.

sources.text: National Academy of Agricultural Sciences - Prof. Zora Singh biographical profile
Indian Link - The shelf life scientist: Prof Zora Singh wins world honour in horticulture

caption:
He was born in a Punjab village. In 2026, he became the first Australian to win horticulture's top global honor.

Born in village Aitiana, Ludhiana, Punjab, on August 10, 1956, he earned his BSc, MSc and PhD at Punjab Agricultural University before a postdoc in the UK and a move to Australia in the 1990s.

The ASHS award is described as the field's highest global honor - and he's the first Australian ever to receive it, after a career built entirely on a Punjab Agricultural University education.

Singh's path - from a Punjab village to Australia's top horticulture chair - shows how far an Indian agricultural science education can carry someone who takes it seriously.
